comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-1956 breaks a cocktail-shaker seal and separates the tins without spilling.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires concentric driver-and-wrench countertorque that preserves an angular setting; PR-1956 requires holding one tin and delivering a correctly placed impact before lifting the other.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked 90° setting, limited drift, three repeatable cycles, retained hardware, and released clearance; PR-1956 requires blow-caused seal release, separated upright tins, clear hands, and no dent, spill, or loss.
comparison.reason: Placed impact and spill-safe vessel separation do not test coupled screw adjustment, locknut reaction control, or post-lock functional retention; both rubrics provide material numeric details.
